principles: Safety and integrity are gates, not weighted score components.
No single weighted quality-cost score is used.
Primary E2E outcome is Business Task Success (BTS) per case.
Exact SIX node routes are diagnostic only and cannot penalize valid SINGLE/THREE E06-A executions.
Gold comparisons use field semantics: strict invariants, set inclusion/exclusion, constraint envelopes, or calibrated semantic rubric as declared; raw JSON equality is not the default.
Core, Stress, and Holdout are reported separately; denominators and pass counts are always shown.
Efficiency is compared only among candidates that pass required safety and minimum quality floors.

per_case.hard_contract_pass: all applicable HARD_GATE and deterministic critical contract graders PASS
per_case.semantic_task_pass: calibrated grader.e2e.semantic PASS where free-text task quality is applicable; NOT_APPLICABLE is allowed only for deterministic block/interaction-only cases

aggregation.primary: Within each split, report case-level BTS micro as the headline count/percentage and category/scenario-family macro as balance diagnostics; do not average CORE, STRESS, and HOLDOUT together.
aggregation.split_policy: CORE, STRESS, HOLDOUT never pooled into one headline score; report each numerator/denominator explicitly.
aggregation.partial_runs: reported separately and never silently counted as full success
aggregation.not_applicable: excluded from denominator with explicit count

candidate_selection: 1. Reject any candidate that fails required Safety/Integrity Gate.
2. Apply pre-registered minimum quality floors for the experiment stage.
3. Compare BTS and paired case outcomes; inspect scenario-family macro performance and failure severity.
4. Use process diagnostics to explain differences, not to compensate for failed business tasks.
5. Use cost, token, call count and p95 latency as Pareto/tie-break dimensions among quality-qualified candidates.
6. Final decision requires repeatability/Holdout/Stress/Human Review and Product Decision Record.

holdout_reporting.minimum_floor: at least 10/12 case passes (83.3%) per declared finalist evaluation policy
holdout_reporting.interpretation: This is a release floor, not statistical proof of superiority. Always report exact pass count, percentage, repeated-trial consistency and confidence interval where available.

e06a.forbidden: SIX exact node route as common 1/3/6 scoring target

gold_comparison_semantics.STRICT: policy, forbidden side effects, approval/verification/end-state and explicitly fixed identifiers/arguments must match contract
gold_comparison_semantics.SET: required items must be present; forbidden items must be absent; allowed extras follow scope rules
gold_comparison_semantics.CONSTRAINT_ENVELOPE: budget numbers are upper/lower bounds as declared; a more efficient valid plan is not penalized for not matching Gold numerically
gold_comparison_semantics.ORDERED_PREFERENCE: order is graded only where dependency or business priority is explicitly part of Gold
gold_comparison_semantics.SEMANTIC_RUBRIC: calibrated meaning/usefulness judgment, never allowed to override a hard deterministic failure

repeatability_reporting.full_core: candidate comparisons use paired case outcomes across declared repeats; show wins/losses/ties and bootstrap CI
repeatability_reporting.holdout: 3 trials per finalist; report trial-level BTS and per-case consistency, not only the pooled mean
repeatability_reporting.stress: report by failure family and severity in addition to overall count
